mapper.sql: SELECT draft.*, base.version_number AS base_version_number, creator.user_id AS creator_user_id, creator.username AS creator_username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_image image WHERE image.dataset_id=draft.working_dataset_id AND image.is_deleted=FALSE) AS image_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_file file_entry WHERE file_entry.dataset_id=draft.working_dataset_id AND file_entry.is_deleted=FALSE) AS file_count FROM dataset_version_draft draft JOIN dataset_version base ON base.version_id=draft.base_version_id LEFT JOIN auth_user creator ON creator.user_key=draft.created_by WHERE draft.dataset_id=#{datasetId}
mapper.select: SELECT dataset_id FROM dataset WHERE dataset_id=#{value} AND version_working_copy=TRUE FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_version_draft(draft_id, dataset_id, working_dataset_id, base_version_id, name, change_note, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{draftId}, #{datasetId}, #{workingDatasetId}, #{baseVersionId}, #{name}, #{changeNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE dataset_version_draft SET name=#{name}, change_note=#{changeNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at=#{updatedAt}, updated_by=#{updatedBy} WHERE draft_id=#{draftId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset(dataset_id, name, description, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, workspace_id, version_working_copy) SELECT #{draft.workingDatasetId}, #{base.name}, #{base.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{draft.createdAt}, #{draft.updatedAt}, created_by, #{draft.updatedBy}, workspace_id, TRUE FROM dataset WHERE dataset_id=#{draft.datasetId}

INSERT INTO dataset_version(version_id, dataset_id, version_number, name, description, change_note, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{versionId}, #{datasetId}, #{versionNumber}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{changeNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number),0)+1 FROM dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId}
mapper.sql: SELECT v.*, creator.user_id AS creator_user_id, creator.username AS creator_username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_version_image i WHERE i.version_id=v.version_id) AS image_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_version_file f WHERE f.version_id=v.version_id) AS file_count FROM dataset_version v LEFT JOIN auth_user creator ON creator.user_key=v.created_by WHERE v.dataset_id=#{datasetId}
mapper.select: AND v.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY v.version_number DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dataset_version SET is_deleted=TRUE, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by=#{actor} WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} AND version_id=#{versionId} AND is_deleted=FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_version_image(version_id, image_id, original_filename, description, media_type, size_bytes, version_count, source_created_at, source_created_by, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT #{versionId}, image_id, original_filename, description, media_type, size_bytes, version_count, created_at, created_by, #{now}, #{now}, #{actor}, #{actor} FROM dataset_image WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} AND is_deleted=FALSE

INSERT INTO dataset_version_file(version_id, file_id, original_filename, description, media_type, size_bytes, version_count, source_created_at, source_created_by, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT #{versionId}, file_id, original_filename, description, media_type, size_bytes, version_count, created_at, created_by, #{now}, #{now}, #{actor}, #{actor} FROM dataset_file WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} AND is_deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT snap.original_filename, source.storage_path, source.thumbnail_path FROM dataset_version_image snap JOIN dataset_image source ON source.image_id=snap.image_id WHERE snap.version_id=#{versionId} AND snap.image_id=#{entryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dataset SET name=#{version.name}, description=#{version.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at=#{now}, updated_by=#{actor} WHERE dataset_id=#{version.datasetId}
